name: @45ck/openauslmsk12
description: Monorepo scaffold for the OpenAusLMSK12 planning and implementation workstream.

scripts.ci: npm run ci:workspaces && npm run ci:backend
scripts.ci:workspaces: npm run format:check --workspaces --if-present && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && npm run spell --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:coverage --workspaces --if-present
scripts.noslop:doctor: node ./scripts/noslop.js doctor || echo "noslop unavailable; gate files should be present in repo."
scripts.noslop:fast: node ./scripts/noslop.js check --tier=fast || (npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run spell)
scripts.noslop:slow: node ./scripts/noslop.js check --tier=slow || (npm run typecheck && npm run test)
